map.患者健康问卷躯体症状模块(PHQ-15)，评估过去一个月内15项躯体症状的困扰程: Patient Health Questionnaire somatic module (PHQ-15) rates bother from 15 somatic symptoms over the past month. Each 0-2, total 0-30; >=10 suggests moderate-severe somatic symptoms, further assessment advised.
map.PHQ-15总分 = Σ15个躯体症状条目（每项0-2，满分30）；≤4最小、5: PHQ-15 total = sum of 15 somatic items (0-2, max 30); <=4 minimal, 5-9 low, 10-14 medium, >=15 high somatic distress.
map.建议进一步医学与心理评估: Further medical and psychological assessment advised
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代医学检查与精神科诊断。躯体症状应先排除器质性疾病，: This is a self-help screening tool and does not replace medical exams or psychiatric diagnosis. Rule out organic disease first, then consider psychosomatic factors.
map.15 项 0–2（无/有些/很多）：胃肠2、疲劳2、疼痛2、头晕1、心悸1、呼吸: 15 items 0-2 (none/some/a lot): GI 2, fatigue 2, pain 2, dizziness 1, palpitations 1, dyspnea 1, back pain 1, chest pain 1, other 1 = 12, moderate somatic burden.
map.合计 5，轻度，关注诱因与情绪关联。: Total 5, mild; note triggers and emotional links.
map.0–4 轻，5–9 中，10–15 重；高分提示需排查器质性并关注抑郁焦虑共病。: 0-4 mild, 5-9 medium, 10-15 severe; high scores suggest ruling out organic causes and checking depression/anxiety comorbidity.
map.用于初级保健识别躯体化与心身障碍，不替代专科查体。: Used in primary care to identify somatization and psychosomatic disorders; not a substitute for specialist exam.
map.躯体化(PHQ-15)症状评估器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Somatic Symptom Scale (PHQ-15). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
